episode_title: Upcoming Products, AI Detail Content + Ranking Carson's Cars! | September 25, 2026 | MAIN SHOW #330

real_qa.q: What is The Rag Company TRC Ambassador program and how does it differ from the Grand Ambassador program?
real_qa.r: The TRC Ambassador program, announced at TRCMill last year, expanded access from the previous Grand Ambassador program to a larger pool of people. It allows ambassadors to use gear they already have and make money on the side through recommendations, though it won't replace a full-time job. The program includes different tier levels that may provide product benefits depending on participation level.
real_qa.requete: TRC Ambassador program The Rag Company

real_qa.q: Does The Rag Company have a TikTok Shop and how are orders processed?
real_qa.r: Yes, The Rag Company has a TikTok Shop where all orders funnel through their Boise campus. Some items are fulfilled by TikTok (FBT) for faster shipping similar to Amazon. TikTok Shop occasionally offers significant discounts of 50% to 80% off items through various campaigns, though the regular website is recommended for standard shopping.

real_qa.q: What is Carson Black's approach to using AI tools for content creation?
real_qa.r: Carson uses AI selectively and sparingly for specific tasks rather than generating entire pieces. He uses AI to remove unwanted elements from thumbnails, tweak backgrounds, and generate specific details like license plates with raised letters. He emphasizes that AI should enhance human creativity rather than replace it, and warns against relying on it as a complete solution for content generation.

real_qa.q: What are Carson Black's criteria for selecting detailing products as a tester at The Rag Company?
real_qa.r: Carson prioritizes cost-effectiveness and value—specifically getting the most washes per product compared to cheaper alternatives. He looks for products that cost slightly more but provide significantly better performance, ensuring customers get more bang for their buck rather than buying cheap soap that requires using half a bottle per wash.
real_qa.requete: product testing cost efficiency detailing soap

real_qa.q: Who was the previous Grand Ambassador of the Year that Carson Black highlighted at The Rag Company?
real_qa.r: Copperhead was highlighted as the previous Grand Ambassador of the Year. He recently visited The Rag Company studio while filming a 50 states detail project, specifically working on an Idaho episode. Carson praised him for creating great content and maintaining good vibes.

guest.bio_context: Carson Black has worked at The Rag Company for almost two years, managing Instagram and TikTok content while producing short-form videos for those platforms. Previously, he was a service advisor at a Honda dealership and has been a long-time follower of The Rag Company before joining the team. He runs a small car washing business on the side and is involved in product R&D and testing for the company.

real_quote: Using AI tools, stuff like that definitely has its place, but the difference is using original content and making your own content—that's still a big thing for sure.
